choices.why: The light ash desk with tapered legs is pure Nordic style, and at 118 cm it fits well beside the window without crowding the space.
The bentwood birch swivel chair on casters matches the light wood of the desk, and its curved shell is comfortable for working.
This tall birch bookcase wall with glass doors makes good use of the long white wall on the right, holds plenty of books and stays in light wood.
The birch rocking chair with a natural-white cushion is a comfortable, very Nordic reading seat that repeats the light wood of the desk and bookcase.
The swing arm lets you aim the light over the rocking chair for reading, and the white shade with nickel finish stays light and minimal.

answer.why: Birch and light ash repeat across all the pieces and match the light wood floor and white walls for a calm, cohesive Nordic corner. The white lamp shade and cushion add softness without breaking the bright palette.
